subject: Preserve moving-sword state on blocked terminal movement
description: A terminal blocked strafe correctly made its movement element Impossible but Rust's shared abort cleanup also invented WaitingSword. Original Human sword-movement Execute has no ABORTED switch arm, so the live MovingSword or MovingFastSword action state survives while Actor::Hourglass rejects the element. Aborted sword movement now retains those live combat-motion states, while nonmoving and ordinary movement families keep their established normalization. Focused state and blocked-order controls pass and the representative matches exact EOF.
